cd /workspace && python3 -B - <<'PY' > /tmp/dense.plan
import random
random.seed(44);R=64;V=2;C=12;B=256
lines=['PLAN 1',f'{C} 1 256 16 16 16 {V} {B}']
verts=[]
for v in range(V):
 st=[0]
 for i in range(1,R):st.append(st[-1]+random.randint(1,1000))
 hp=[random.randrange(2**31) for _ in range(R)];verts.append((st,hp))
 lines.append(str(R));lines += [f'{x:032x} {h}' for x,h in zip(st,hp)]
for b in range(B):
 v=b%2;rep=1000000;aa=[]
 st,hp=verts[v]
 for _ in range(32):
  r=random.randrange(R);aa.append(st[r])
 lines.append(f'{v} {rep} 32 '+' '.join(f'{a:032x}' for a in aa))
print('\n'.join(lines))
PY
TIMEFORMAT='elapsed %3R user %3U sys %3S'; time timeout 120 tmp/engine_test < /tmp/dense.plan > /tmp/dense.out; echo rc=$? bytes=$(stat -c%s /tmp/dense.out)
